plain: A body of troops or people organized for one purpose.

webster.text: In military language, a body of troops; any division of an army; as a corps de reserve.

more.text: A body, in contempt, as used by Milton and Dryden, but probably pronounced in the English manner, as corpse.
In architecture, any part that projects beyond a wall, serving as the ground of some decoration.

example.quote: The latter resource of permanent corps in the pay of the government amounts to a standing army in time of peace; a small one, indeed, but not the less real for being small.
